title: PPI AG and Endava rank on a mechanical v2 rescore with no OSS-portfolio screen behind it
content:
These two leads were derived rather than scored: their v2 rows were rescored mechanically on size and slot occupancy only, they were never assessed on the v3 rubric, and the instruction attached to them is to run the OSS-portfolio screen before acting. The recorded v2 verticals are banking, insurance and payments.

What the rank does not encode is the thing the corpus is organised around. There is no tool-level evidence for either lead — PPI AG's tool column reads "not researched (owns payments products)" and Endava's simply "not researched" — so nothing is known about whether either runs the open-source tooling that the whole record-layer argument attaches to. PPI AG sits at "4 · needs OSS screen" and Endava at "9 · do not pitch", and only the first of those reflects the missing screen; the second is a slot or size judgement.

The same flag text, differing only in the recorded verticals, is attached to a separate group of Danish banking leads. Read together they describe a property of the provisional v2 ranking tail rather than of any particular company, and the actionable content is identical: the rank is a placeholder until the screen is run.
